name: android-friend-notifications
title: Friend-request push notifications with an on/off setting and a permission explainer
issue: Android issue #57, notifications part (PR must say 'Part of #57'). Depends on backend PR for branch push-friend-requests (read its API_SPEC.md section for the exact device-registration and notification-preferences contract; if that PR is not merged yet, read it from the branch via gh/git and build against it; do not guess shapes). BUILD: (1) FCM receive path: a FirebaseMessagingService, a notification channel 'Friend requests', a notification that opens the Friends screen on tap, text from the payload (sender display name and @username). Build MUST still compile and run with NO Firebase config: apply the google-services plugin and Firebase dependencies so that a missing google-services.json does not break assembleDevDebug/CI or crash the app (push simply stays inactive and registration is skipped); document how to add the file (never commit it, it is gitignored) in docs. (2) Token registration: register/refresh the FCM token with the backend device endpoint after sign-in and on token refresh, unregister on sign-out; failures retried quietly. (3) Setting: a 'Friend requests' toggle in Settings notifications, mirrored to the backend notification-preferences endpoint (server is the source of truth so a push is never sent when off) and honoured locally too; default ON. (4) Permission explainer per the docs/SPEC.md rule added in PR #62 (merge origin/master; if that rule is not on master yet, base your docs edit so it merges cleanly): on Android 13+ the POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission is requested only from an in-app explainer that asks, explains and nudges, handles denial gracefully (setting shows 'off in system settings' with a deep link), and is shown in context (e.g. after the first friend request is sent or when enabling the toggle), not at app start. (5) Tests for the preference mapping, registration lifecycle and explainer state; screenshot baselines only for intended UI. Do not touch the existing lesson-reminder notifications except to share the explainer component if natural. Gradle: one task at a time.
acceptance: Builds and runs with no Firebase config; push inactive without it
Token registration lifecycle and server-mirrored friend-requests toggle
Permission explainer shown in context, denial handled
Gradle tests, screenshot verification, lint and assembleDevDebug green locally
